video_title: Steph Curry Just Told Us the End Is Near

quotes.excerpt: Do you think Steph's gonna stay healthy for the next two and a half years?
quotes.quote: Maybe he's only gonna play for the next two and a half plus years. So he's the number one guy, and everything revolves around him. He's already missed four games of 14. This is a roller coaster, and it hurts. They haven't even played together yet, those three guys. Do you think Steph's gonna stay healthy for the next two and a half years?

quotes.speaker: Steiny
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's perspective on his current three-year contract extension
quotes.excerpt: I knew it was gonna be one of the last, if not the last, contract I signed.
quotes.quote: Anthony Slater of ESPN had a story about Steph Curry today, and Curry says that look, when he signed his three-year deal, he said, I knew it was gonna be one of the last, if not the last, contract I signed. And I know it can be over after that. Maybe I'll surprise myself and play longer. But as of right now, he's operating under the premise that this might be his last contract.

quotes.speaker: Steiny
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' challenging schedule and Steph Curry's injury recovery timeline
quotes.excerpt: So he's already missed four games, he's gonna miss the next at least the next seven.
quotes.quote: Maybe he's only gonna play for the next two and a half plus years. So he's already missed four games of 14. And he's gonna miss the next at least the next seven. Let's say at least the next seven. So he's already missed, he's gonna miss 11 games when he comes back. There's 12 back-to-backs remaining after that, assuming he hasn't been cleared to play back-to-backs. So we're already down to about 60, 62 games, assuming no more setbacks for Steph Curry.

quotes.speaker: Guru
quotes.summary_phrase: The gravity of Steph Curry's impact on the Warriors' roster
quotes.excerpt: I'm a use the G-word, the gravity of one Steph and Wardell Curry to his other teammates.

text_blocks.speaker: Steiny
text_blocks.text: How is a fan to deal with, okay, we're 0-3, we stink, this team's terrible, Steph misses a game in one of those first three, then they win eight in a row, and now everybody's back on board, this team can and now they they've lost three in a row and they've played most of them without Steph, and now they they're not very good again.

text_blocks.speaker: Guru
text_blocks.text: I'm the prime example from a fan standpoint to where this is, this is a roller coaster and it hurts and you start to see and you're just reminded and I knew, but I was in denial and I'm a use the G-word, the gravity of one Steph and Wardell Curry to his other teammates on the basketball floor. So to hear Steve Kerr basically say, shout out on Aunt Jemima, he's gonna start from scratch in regard to he doesn't know what and who is going to, well we know who, Jax is going to be in the starting lineup, but he's back at ground zero because nothing's clicking right now, just gives you some insight as to again, the gravity of one Steph Curry.

quotes.speaker: Guru
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga's struggles and the Warriors' reliance on him
quotes.excerpt: We put everything under the sun on Jax, who had great success to start the season.
quotes.quote: To be down 24 after one quarter to a lowly and I'll call him that and I know Zion played, New Orleans Pelican team, you know, I buckled up thinking, you know what, if we can win a game on this road trip and hopefully more, this will be the one. But all of a sudden, we look like we got cement feet, Draymond Green starting, so we're already four on five and I'm part of it. We put everything under the sun on Jax, who had great success to start the season, but all of a sudden it seems like upstairs and he's 24 years old mentally, he's taking it hard because he feels like, you know, it's all on him and it's not. But I'm just looking around like and again, there is no Brandin Podziemski.

quotes.speaker: Steiny
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of Jonathan Kuminga's role without Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: It's a tough role and it has to do with Steph Curry and just his sheer greatness.
quotes.quote: The other thing that's unfair to Jax and it's it's a tough role and it has to do with Steph Curry and just his sheer greatness. The difference between the Warriors with and without Steph Curry is so drastic that it's just not it's not it's not as easy as it sounds to say, okay, so Jax, you're gonna play with Steph Curry for a lot of the time and he's the greatest player in our franchise's history, so he's the number one guy and everything revolves around him and pretty much a lot of what we do offensively is based on him.

quotes.speaker: Guru
quotes.summary_phrase: The emotional impact of the Warriors' early season struggles
quotes.excerpt: I was so excited and enamored with the possibilities that I went down the road mentally.
quotes.quote: The pain, that's the word I'll use, because when they got off to this great start, I was so excited and enamored with the possibilities that I went down the road mentally and thought about look at this team when Jimmy Butler comes back with Moses Moody. But now that Steph and basically the show has gone down, now I'm feeling the pain and the brunt of not having Jimmy, because now I look at this team that shot 23% from three last night, 11 of 46 and it wasn't inside out, it was just all we can get it felt like to me was a three so we're gonna jack it up there and for the second straight game nobody could hit.

text_blocks.speaker: Guru
text_blocks.text: I think it was Evan Mobley, they dubbed it Operation Hold It Down. Holding it down is not gonna be enough. Well, these last two games, that ain't holding it down. They're in ninth right now in the Western Conference. And they they got the fourth, the Friday before you got back, they were, they were four for fifth and it just looked good for my mental seeing them there outside the box as they say on the postgame show on NBC.
